descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti brillanti e li ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. DevOps Engineer Zurigo | Modulo di lavoro fino al 40% | Reference 7891 Sei entusiasta dell'opportunità di modellare piattaforme applicative affidabili e ad alte prestazioni in un ambiente moderno DevOps?

Ti piace combinare automazione, operazioni e innovazione per costruire servizi resilienti pronti per la produzione su scala? Stiamo cercando un ingegnere DevOps per aiutare a guidare implementazioni automatizzate, GitOps-based delivery, e infrastruttura-code in tutto il cloud e ambienti on-premise. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con team di sviluppo delle applicazioni per garantire stabilità, bassa latenza e operazioni sicure migliorando continuamente i flussi di lavoro, monitoraggio e resilienza delle piattaforme.

Cosa farete • Progettare, implementare e mantenere i flussi di lavoro di distribuzione automatizzati utilizzando Ansible e GitLab CI/CD. • Implementa i processi di distribuzione end-to-end GitOps utilizzando GitLab CI/CD, compresa la promozione dell'ambiente, le strategie di rollout e la gestione della configurazione. • Costruire e mantenere soluzioni infrastrutturali come codice per componenti di applicazioni e piattaforme utilizzando strumenti come Helm, Terraform e Ansible per garantire modifiche ripetibili e verificabili.

• Supporto e ottimizzazione dell'infrastruttura on-premise e cloud, comprese le piattaforme Microsoft e l'amministrazione Azure, con un focus sulla resilienza, le prestazioni e la disponibilità a bassa latenza. • Definire e migliorare continuamente il monitoraggio, l'allerta, i cruscotti e i runbook per rafforzare la stabilità operativa e la risposta agli incidenti. • Sviluppare script di automazione e integrazione in PowerShell, Python, Perl, Bash e CMD, e lavorare con formati strutturati come XML, JSON e XSL ove necessario. • Operare e supportare il monitoraggio e le piattaforme di pianificazione dei lavori come Patrol, Elastic, Grafana e Airflow.

• Collaborare con team di sviluppo, infrastruttura e sicurezza per garantire la consegna affidabile, operazioni stabili e risoluzione dei problemi efficaci che portate • Forte mentalità DevOps con esperienza attraverso il ciclo di vita del software e sistemi di produzione operativi. • Esperienza pratica con l'infrastruttura IT aziendale in ambienti complessi, tra cui Cisco, Windows, Linux, Active Directory, Kerberos e piattaforme virtualizzate.

• Forte capacità di scripting in Python e shell, insieme all'esperienza pratica utilizzando GitLab CI/CD; esperienza con Ansible e infrastruttura-as-code è molto apprezzato. • Solida comprensione di Linux, fondamentali di rete e concetti di containerizzazione come Docker, Podman, OpenShift immagini, registri, runtime e sicurezza. • Esperienza con il monitoraggio, allerta e soluzioni di registrazione come il Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Splunk, o strumenti simili in ambienti containerizzati.

• Forte consapevolezza della sicurezza, compresa la gestione dei certificati PKI, l'amministrazione dei firewall, la gestione delle vulnerabilità e il lavoro in ambienti consapevoli della sicurezza. • Ottima capacità di risoluzione dei problemi e un approccio strutturato alla gestione degli incidenti, problemi, rilascio e cambiamenti. • Esperienza a supporto della stabilità operativa, conformità, pianificazione del disaster recovery, documentazione e collaborazione cross-funzionale. • Chiara capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di spiegare argomenti tecnici sia a pubblico tecnico che non tecnico. • Inglese fluente; tedesco e/o spagnolo sono un vantaggio.

Se avete domande, date un'occhiata alla nostra pagina FAQ o chiamate Yuliya Stoyko al +34 917095993. Per questo posto vacante accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi sfondo personale. <script type="text/javasc
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

DevOps Engineer

Zurich | Working form home up to 40% | Reference 7891

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape reliable, high-performing application platforms in a modern DevOps environment? Do you enjoy combining automation, operations, and innovation to build resilient services that are ready for production at scale? We are looking for an Application DevOps Engineer to help drive automated deployments, GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code across cloud and on-premise environments. In this role, you will work closely with application development teams to ensure stable, low-latency, and secure operations while continuously improving deployment workflows, monitoring, and platform resilience.

What You Will Do

• Design, implement, and maintain automated deployment workflows using Ansible and GitLab CI/CD.

• Own end‑to‑end GitOps deployment processes using GitLab CI/CD, including environment promotion, rollout strategies and configuration management.

• Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for application and platform components using tools such as Helm, Terraform, and Ansible to ensure repeatable, auditable changes.

• Support and optimize on-premise and cloud infrastructure, including Microsoft platforms and Azure administration, with a focus on resilience, performance, and low-latency readiness.

• Define and continuously improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks to strengthen operational stability and incident response.

• Develop automation and integration scripts in PowerShell, Python, Perl, Bash, and CMD, and work with structured formats such as XML, JSON, and XSL where required.

• Operate and support monitoring and job scheduling platforms such as Patrol, Elastic, Grafana, and Airflow.

• Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure reliable delivery, stable operations, and effective problem resolutio

What You Bring

• Strong DevOps mindset with experience across the software delivery lifecycle and operating production systems.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise IT infrastructure in complex environments, including Cisco, Windows, Linux, Active Directory, Kerberos, and virtualized platforms.

• Strong scripting skills in Python and shell, along with practical experience using GitLab CI/CD; experience with Ansible and infrastructure-as-code is highly valued.

• Solid understanding of Linux, networking fundamentals, and containerization concepts such as Docker, Podman, OpenShift images, registries, runtime, and security.

• Experience with monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Splunk, or similar tools in containerized environments.

• Strong security awareness, including PKI certificate handling, firewall administration, vulnerability management, and work in security-conscious environments.

• Excellent troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to incident, problem, release, and change management.

• Experience supporting operational stability, compliance, disaster recovery planning, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Fluent English; German and/or Spanish are an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran. Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen die Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Finanzen mit uns. DevOps Engineer Zürich, Working form home up to 40%, Reference 7891 Sind Sie begeistert von der Möglichkeit, zuverlässige, leistungsstarke Anwendungsplattformen in einer modernen DevOps-Umgebung zu gestalten?

Sie verbinden Automatisierung, Betrieb und Innovation gerne, um widerstandsfähige Services aufzubauen, die produktionsbereit sind? Wir suchen einen Anwendungs-DevOps-Ingenieur, der Ihnen hilft, automatisierte Bereitstellungen, GitOps-basierte Bereitstellung und Infrastruktur-as-Code in Cloud- und On-Premise-Umgebungen zu betreiben. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie eng mit Anwendungsentwicklungsteams zusammen, um stabile, latenzarme und sichere Operationen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Bereitstellungs-Workflows, Überwachung und Plattform-Resilienz zu verbessern.

Was Sie tun werden • Entwerfen, implementieren und pflegen Sie automatisierte Bereitstellungs-Workflows mit Ansible und GitLab CI/CD. • Eigene End-to-End-GitOps-Deployment-Prozesse mit GitLab CI/CD, einschließlich Umweltförderung, Rollout-Strategien und Konfigurationsmanagement. • Erstellen und pflegen Sie Infrastruktur-as-Code-Lösungen für Anwendungs- und Plattformkomponenten mit Tools wie Helm, Terraform und Ansible, um wiederholbare, auditierbare Änderungen zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung und Optimierung der On-Premise- und Cloud-Infrastruktur, einschließlich Microsoft-Plattformen und Azure-Administration, mit Schwerpunkt auf Widerstandsfähigkeit, Leistung und geringer Latenzbereitschaft. • Definieren und kontinuierlich verbessern Sie Überwachung, Alarmierung, Dashboards und Runbooks, um die operative Stabilität und Reaktion auf Störungen zu stärken. • Entwicklung von Automatisierungs- und Integrationsskripten in PowerShell, Python, Perl, Bash und CMD und Arbeit mit strukturierten Formaten wie XML, JSON und XSL, falls erforderlich. • Betrieb und Unterstützung von Überwachungs- und Jobplanungsplattformen wie Patrol, Elastic, Grafana und Airflow.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs-, Infrastruktur- und Sicherheitsteams, um eine zuverlässige Bereitstellung, stabile Operationen und effektive Problemlösung zu gewährleisten. Was Sie mitbringen • Starke DevOps-Geist mit Erfahrung über den gesamten Softwarelieferzyklus und die Betriebssysteme der Produktion. • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Enterprise-IT-Infrastruktur in komplexen Umgebungen, einschließlich Cisco, Windows, Linux, Active Directory, Kerberos und virtualisierten Plattformen.

• Starke Skriptfähigkeiten in Python und Shell, sowie praktische Erfahrungen mit GitLab CI/CD; Erfahrung mit Ansible und Infrastruktur-as-Code wird hoch geschätzt. • Solides Verständnis von Linux, Netzwerkgrundlagen und Containerisierungskonzepten wie Docker, Podman, OpenShift-Images, Registrierungen, Laufzeiten und Sicherheit. • Erfahrung mit Überwachungs-, Alarmierungs- und Protokollierungslösungen wie Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Splunk oder ähnlichen Tools in containerisierten Umgebungen.

• Starke Sicherheitsbewusstsein, einschließlich PKI-Zertifikatshandling, Firewall-Verwaltung, Sicherheitsmanagement und Arbeit in sicherheitsbewussten Umgebungen. • Ausgezeichnete Fehlerbehebung Fähigkeiten und ein strukturierter Ansatz für das Ereignis-, Problem-, Release- und Change-Management. • Erfahrung, die Betriebsstabilität, Compliance, Katastrophenrettung Planung, Dokumentation und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit unterstützt. • Klare Kommunikation Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, technische Themen sowohl für technische als auch nicht-technische Zielgruppen zu erklären. • Fließendes Englisch; Deutsch und/oder Spanisch sind ein Vorteil.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Yuliya Stoyko unter +34 917095993. Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur direkte Bewerbungen. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von jedem persönlichen Hintergrund. <script type="text/javasc

SIX est un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. DevOps Engineer Zurich, Working form home up to 40%, Référence 7891 Êtes-vous excité par la possibilité de façonner des plateformes d'application fiables et performantes dans un environnement DevOps moderne?

Vous aimez combiner l'automatisation, les opérations et l'innovation pour construire des services résilients prêts à la production à grande échelle? Nous recherchons un ingénieur Application DevOps pour aider à piloter des déploiements automatisés, la livraison basée sur GitOps et l'infrastructure comme code dans les environnements cloud et sur prémise. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement d'applications pour assurer des opérations stables, à faible latence et sécurisées tout en améliorant continuellement les flux de travail, le suivi et la résilience des plateformes.

Ce que vous ferez • Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir des flux de travail automatisés de déploiement à l'aide d'Ansible et GitLab CI/CD. • Déployer des processus de déploiement de bout en bout GitOps en utilisant GitLab CI/CD, y compris la promotion de l'environnement, les stratégies de déploiement et la gestion de la configuration. • Construire et maintenir des solutions d'infrastructure comme code pour les composants d'application et de plate-forme à l'aide d'outils tels que Helm, Terraform et Ansible pour assurer des changements répétables et vérifiables.

• Soutenir et optimiser l'infrastructure de pré-mise en service et de cloud, y compris les plateformes Microsoft et l'administration Azure, en mettant l'accent sur la résilience, les performances et la disponibilité à faible latence. • Définir et améliorer continuellement la surveillance, l'alerte, les tableaux de bord et les runbooks pour renforcer la stabilité opérationnelle et la réponse aux incidents. • Développer des scripts d'automatisation et d'intégration dans PowerShell, Python, Perl, Bash et CMD, et travailler avec des formats structurés tels que XML, JSON et XSL, si nécessaire. • Utiliser et soutenir des plateformes de surveillance et de planification des tâches telles que Patrol, Elastic, Grafana et Airflow.

• Collaborez avec des équipes de développement, d'infrastructure et de sécurité pour assurer une livraison fiable, des opérations stables et une résolution efficace des problèmes.

• Des compétences de script solides en Python et shell, ainsi que l'expérience pratique avec GitLab CI/CD; l'expérience avec Ansible et infrastructure-as-code est très appréciée. • Une compréhension solide des concepts Linux, de base de réseau et de conteneurisation tels que Dockers, Podman, OpenShift images, registres, runtime, et sécurité. • Expérience avec des solutions de surveillance, d'alerte et de logage telles que Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Spunk, ou des outils similaires dans des environnements conteneurisés.

• Une bonne sensibilisation à la sécurité, y compris la gestion des certificats de l'ICP, l'administration des pare-feu, la gestion de la vulnérabilité et le travail dans des environnements soucieux de la sécurité. • Des compétences exceptionnelles en matière de dépannage et une approche structurée de la gestion des incidents, des problèmes, des libérations et des changements. • Une expérience en matière de stabilité opérationnelle, de conformité, de planification de la reprise après sinistre, de documentation et de collaboration interfonctionnelle. • Des compétences claires en matière de communication avec la capacité d'expliquer des sujets techniques aux publics techniques et non techniques. • Un anglais fluide; l'allemand et/ou l'espagnol sont un avantage.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Yuliya Stoyko au +34 917095993. Pour cette vacance nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir les candidatures indépendamment de tout contexte personnel. <script type="text/javasc

At SIX, we value your technical talent and your passion for building exceptional solutions with a strong focus on user experience. As part of the Stock Exchange Development team, you will contribute to both front-end and back-end components of our state-of-the-art trading products. In this Software Engineer role. What You Will Do
• apply your strong Java development skills (Java 8+/11) to build high‑performance backend systems and enhance our Reference Data Managem
• translate user expectations and business requirements into innovative, high-quality technical designs, following Java best practices to deliver impactful solutions.

descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Specialist HR Service Center (80-100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% Home Office | Reference 7951

For our dedicated Employee Lifecycle Team, we are looking for an experienced person as a Specialist HR Service Center (m/f) who will provide administrative support for the HR lifecycle from entry to exit for our line managers and employees. As part of our People Vision at SIX, we aim to continuously motivate and inspire our employees. In an exciting environment at the intersection of technology and finance within a dynamic and innovative company, SIX offers you diverse opportunities to fully contribute and develop your potential. We are a collaborative and dynamic team with a strong team spirit, shaping a culture-changing future at SIX together with the business.

The position is temporary until December 2027.

What You Will Do

• First-level support for all line managers and employees on administrative HR topics from entry to exit, as well as general labour law questions, including information on processes, time recording, absences, and fringe benefits

• Independent, accurate, and timely handling of entries, exits, and personnel changes, as well as preparation of contracts, confirmations, and employment references

• Independent updating and maintenance of personnel master data in SuccessFactors

• Responsibility for selected HR specialist topics (e.g. work permits, labour law, digitalisation, fringe benefits)

• Advising employees and line managers on all HR-related matters

What You Bring

• Commercial basic education and a higher professional qualification (e.g. HR specialist certificate)

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar environment

• You are passionate about administrative tasks, can think “outside the box,” enjoy proactively contributing to optimisations, and are happy to take responsibility for their implementation

• Very good user knowledge of MS Office programmes, technical affinity, SAP and/or SuccessFactors is an advantage

• Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
